tests.name: an operator saves a customer
tests.covers: an operator saves Acme Supplies, reloads and still sees it

steps.text: fill name Acme Supplies and email ap@acme.test and save
see the Acme Supplies customer page

tests.name: a duplicate email is refused
tests.covers: saving Acme Again with ap@acme.test, Acme Supplies' email, is refused and nothing is saved

steps.text: save name Acme Supplies with email ap@acme.test
see Acme Supplies in the customer list
save name Acme Again with email ap@acme.test
see the refusal 'A customer with this email already exists'
see exactly one customer with email ap@acme.test, Acme Supplies
